text: Assumption: Start() also acts as a context reset — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Start() also acts as a context reset — is this correct?
norm: start also acts as a context reset
assumption: Start() also acts as a context reset.
rationale: According to SWS_CRYPT_50152, the method aborts ongoing computations, which means that it can be used not only for initial start but also for discarding and restarting.

original.text: Annahme: Start() fungiert auch als Kontext-Reset — trifft das zu?
original.rationale: Laut SWS_CRYPT_50152 bricht die Methode laufende Berechnungen ab, womit sie neben dem Erststart auch zum Verwerfen und Neustarten verwendet werden dürfte.
